boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Loyola Marymount University
boards.description: Ten named campus and westside food stops with directly verified late operating hours; confirm holiday changes before leaving.

cards.title: Lion's Den Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: Malone Student Center, LMU
cards.notes: Start on campus: use the student-run coffee shop’s seating area for a late study break, and check the academic-year schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee and pastry stop with midnight academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies Lion's Den as its only completely student-run coffee shop and lists academic-year hours until midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Lion's Den Coffee Shop — Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–midnight; Saturday–Sunday 11 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Wendy's LAX
cards.subtitle: 7360 La Tijera Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use the La Tijera location when you need a straightforward late food stop; its official page separately lists restaurant and drive-thru closing times.
cards.short_summary: A nearby LAX-area Wendy's with hours extending to 1 or 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists this 7360 La Tijera Boulevard restaurant open until 1 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's LAX in Los Angeles, CA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru: until 1 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday; until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Sepulveda
cards.subtitle: 9149 S. Sepulveda Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.notes: Choose this LAX-area branch for a late drive-thru or dine-in stop; the official location page places it at Sepulveda and 92nd.
cards.short_summary: An LAX-area In-N-Out with late nightly service.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out lists the 9149 S. Sepulveda Boulevard location's normal hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 9149 S. Sepulveda Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: Normal hours: 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Drive-thru and dine-in seating are listed.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger in Marina del Rey
cards.subtitle: 13425 Washington Blvd., Marina del Rey
cards.notes: Head to the Washington Boulevard location for a Marina del Rey option; the official page identifies it as east of Lincoln and by Costco.
cards.short_summary: A Marina del Rey In-N-Out open into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out lists the 13425 Washington Boulevard location's normal hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 13425 Washington Blvd., Marina del Rey
cards.access_notes: Normal hours: 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Drive-thru and dine-in seating are listed.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Century
cards.subtitle: 3411 W. Century Blvd., Inglewood
cards.notes: Use this Century Boulevard branch as an airport-corridor alternative; its official page identifies the site west of Crenshaw and lists drive-thru and seating.
cards.short_summary: An Inglewood In-N-Out with hours past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out lists the 3411 W. Century Boulevard location's normal hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 3411 W. Century Blvd., Inglewood
cards.access_notes: Normal hours: 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Drive-thru and dine-in seating are listed.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 12403 Washington Pl.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Washington Place
cards.subtitle: 12403 Washington Pl., Los Angeles
cards.notes: For an after-hours pickup route toward Marina del Rey, use the drive-thru rather than assuming the lobby remains open after its listed 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Place drive-thru open until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 12403 Washington Place drive-thru open until 4 a.m. daily, while the lobby is listed until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 12403 Washington Pl., Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4 a.m. daily. Lobby: 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 5400 Sepulveda Blvd.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Sepulveda
cards.subtitle: 5400 Sepulveda Blvd., Culver City
cards.notes: Use the Sepulveda Boulevard branch for a drive-thru-only late stop after its lobby closes; verify the current day’s listing before departing.
cards.short_summary: A Culver City drive-thru listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 5400 Sepulveda Boulevard drive-thru open until 4 a.m. daily, while the lobby is listed until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 5400 Sepulveda Blvd., Culver City
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4 a.m. daily. Lobby: 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 10701 Venice Blvd.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Venice
cards.subtitle: 10701 Venice Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.notes: Plan this Venice Boulevard location as a drive-thru stop, since its official page lists substantially earlier lobby hours than its 4 a.m. drive-thru schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Venice Boulevard drive-thru that runs until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 10701 Venice Boulevard drive-thru open until 4 a.m. daily, while the lobby is listed until 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 10701 Venice Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4 a.m. daily. Lobby: 7 a.m.–9 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 2025 Lincoln Blvd.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Lincoln
cards.subtitle: 2025 Lincoln Blvd., Santa Monica
cards.notes: This Lincoln Boulevard location has different late drive-thru hours by day, so check whether it is a weekend run before relying on the 3 a.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Monica drive-thru with 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 2025 Lincoln Boulevard drive-thru until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 2025 Lincoln Blvd., Santa Monica
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until midnight Sunday–Thursday; until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Lobby hours end earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 8605 W. Pico Blvd.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Pico
cards.subtitle: 8605 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use this Pico Boulevard branch when a drive-thru route is workable; the official listing distinguishes its late drive-thru schedule from its 10 p.m. lobby close.
cards.short_summary: A Pico Boulevard drive-thru open through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 8605 W. Pico Boulevard drive-thru open until 4 a.m. daily, while the lobby is listed until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 8605 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4 a.m. daily. Lobby: 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten LMU spaces for collaborative work, computer access, recreation, quiet pauses, reflection, and learning about the bluff’s history.

cards.title: Settle into the Rose Hills Reading Room
cards.subtitle: A named second-floor study space inside William H. Hannon Library
cards.notes: Head to Level 2 when you want a clearly designated reading room; confirm library access and hours before an evening session.
cards.short_summary: A defined library room for focused reading and individual coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies the Rose Hills Reading Room on Level 2 as one of William H. Hannon Library's study spaces.
cards.source_title: About the Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of William H. Hannon Library; follow current library building-access rules and posted hours.

cards.title: Use the Information Commons for computer-based work
cards.subtitle: The Level 1 technology space in William H. Hannon Library
cards.notes: Bring your LMU credentials and start on Level 1 when an assignment needs a campus computer, Windows virtual desktop, or printing.
cards.short_summary: A technology-oriented work area with a substantial bank of library computers.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says the Level 1 Information Commons features 80 Mac computers with Windows virtual desktops; its ITS page also documents multiple printers there.
cards.source_title: About the Library
cards.access_notes: Inside William H. Hannon Library on Level 1; printing and some systems require an LMU OneCard or university credentials.

cards.title: Build a movement break around Burns Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: LMU's campus recreation hub near the Loyola Boulevard entrance
cards.notes: Check the current facility schedule, then choose among the fitness center, courts, group-fitness spaces, pool, or esports center.
cards.short_summary: One campus facility supports several different ways to reset between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU documents a fitness center, group-fitness studios, multipurpose and tennis courts, an Olympic-size outdoor pool, and an Esports Gaming Center at Burns Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Lion Wellness
cards.access_notes: Facility access, membership eligibility, registrations, and operating hours vary; consult Campus Recreation before visiting.

cards.title: Take coursework outside at the Shea Terrace fountains
cards.subtitle: Terraced outdoor space beside University Hall
cards.notes: Use the lawn or terraced levels for a short work session or reset, and take the left-side stairs to compare upper viewpoints.
cards.short_summary: The fountains and tiered grass create an outdoor alternative to an indoor desk.
cards.evidence_claim: An official LMU Newsroom feature locates the fountains outside University Hall and describes the space as an environment where students can work and relax.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use only during permitted campus access and avoid areas closed for maintenance or events.

cards.title: Read the inscriptions in the Interfaith Peace Garden
cards.subtitle: A garden next to Drollinger Parking Plaza
cards.notes: Find the garden beside the parking structure, then use its benches for a pause and read the pillars' peace-focused quotations.
cards.short_summary: A shaded garden pairs seating with inscribed pillars centered on peace.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU locates the Interfaith Peace Garden next to the Drollinger parking structure and documents its grass, shade, stone benches, and quotation-inscribed pillars.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus garden next to Drollinger Parking Plaza; observe current university access rules.

cards.entity_name: Labyrinth at the Garden of Slow Time
cards.title: Walk the Garden of Slow Time labyrinth
cards.subtitle: A contemplative path on LMU's bluff
cards.notes: Approach the labyrinth as a slow walking exercise, pause at the bluff outlook, and leave room for others using it quietly.
cards.short_summary: A designed walking path turns a brief campus break into deliberate reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies the Labyrinth as the Garden of Slow Time's main feature and says it overlooks Playa Vista and the Pacific Ocean.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor bluff location; remain on designated paths and follow current campus and weather-related restrictions.

cards.title: Read the landscape at the Tongva Memorial
cards.subtitle: A bluff-side memorial near LMU student residences
cards.notes: Walk the pavement circle, read the explanatory plaques, and notice the native plantings before taking in the bluff view.
cards.short_summary: Plaques, benches, paving, and plants make this a place for place-based learning.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says the Tongva Memorial was dedicated in 2000 and describes its stone benches, dolphin-motif pavement circle, explanatory plaques, and native plants.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial near student residences; respect residential boundaries and current campus-access policies.

cards.entity_name: Marymount Center for Prayer and Peace
cards.title: Pause in the Marymount Center for Prayer and Peace
cards.subtitle: An interdenominational chapel inside University Hall
cards.notes: Enter quietly when the room is available, explore the represented faith texts respectfully, and leave scheduled activities undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: An indoor chapel provides a multifaith setting for quiet contemplation.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies this University Hall space as an interdenominational chapel containing Hebrew, Christian, and Muslim scriptures.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Inside University Hall; availability may be affected by services or scheduled programs, so honor posted notices.

cards.title: Look closely at Sacred Heart Chapel's stained glass
cards.subtitle: LMU's large campus chapel dating from the 1950s
cards.notes: Step inside quietly when open, use the stained-glass windows as a visual study, and avoid interrupting worship or scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: The chapel offers an architecturally distinct interior for quiet observation.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that Sacred Heart Chapel has served the campus since its construction in the 1950s and highlights its interior and stained-glass windows as a place for reflection.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Chapel access can be limited during liturgies, ceremonies, or private events; enter only when open and permitted.

cards.title: Make space for remembrance at “Ad Astra per Aspera”
cards.subtitle: The student memorial behind the Sacred Heart Chapel tower
cards.notes: Find the sculpture behind the chapel tower, read its plaques respectfully, and keep the immediate memorial area calm for others.
cards.short_summary: A named sculpture and its plaques remember LMU students who died.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies “Ad Astra per Aspera” as a memorial for people who died while students at LMU and locates its plaque-bearing sculpture behind the Sacred Heart Chapel tower.
cards.source_title: Ten Peaceful Places at LMU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial behind Sacred Heart Chapel; approach respectfully and follow current campus-access rules.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission cultural and learning outings in Los Angeles, including one on LMU’s Westchester campus.

cards.title: Browse Laband Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Burns Fine Arts Center · LMU Westchester Campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading over, then enter through the Burns Fine Arts Center courtyard during posted gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: LMU’s campus gallery offers free admission for rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that admission to Laband Art Gallery is free and gives its location in the Burns Fine Arts Center.
cards.source_title: Visit the Gallery | Laband Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Free admission; check current exhibition information and posted hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk the Getty Center galleries and gardens
cards.subtitle: 1200 Getty Center Dr · Brentwood
cards.notes: Reserve a free timed entry first, then build in time for galleries, outdoor terraces, and the Central Garden. Avoid driving if parking is not in budget.
cards.short_summary: A reservation-based, no-admission visit combining art, architecture, and gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: Getty states that Getty Center admission is free and requires a timed-entry reservation; parking carries a fee.
cards.source_title: Getty Center Visitor FAQs
cards.access_notes: A free timed-entry reservation is required. On-site parking costs extra, so use a no-cost arrival option to keep the outing free.

cards.title: Explore the Getty Villa’s antiquities and gardens
cards.subtitle: 17985 Pacific Coast Hwy · Pacific Palisades
cards.notes: Book a free timed ticket before you go, then explore the recreated Roman-villa setting, galleries, and outdoor garden areas at your pace.
cards.short_summary: Greek and Roman art in a reservation-based museum visit by the coast.
cards.evidence_claim: Getty states that Getty Villa admission is free and requires a timed-entry reservation; parking has a fee.
cards.source_title: Getty Villa Museum Visitor FAQs
cards.access_notes: A free timed-entry reservation is required. Parking costs extra, so plan a no-cost arrival option if needed.

cards.title: See what is on view at the Hammer
cards.subtitle: 10899 Wilshire Blvd · Westwood
cards.notes: Drop in for the galleries or time a visit with a listed public tour; the museum says advance reservations are not necessary for regular admission.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission UCLA museum with exhibitions and public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hammer Museum states that admission is free and advance reservations are not necessary.
cards.source_title: Hammer Museum Hours & Directions
cards.access_notes: Museum admission is free; on-site parking is separately priced.

cards.title: Reserve free general admission at The Broad
cards.subtitle: 221 S Grand Ave · Downtown Los Angeles
cards.notes: Reserve a general-admission ticket, then focus your hang on the collection galleries and any installations included with general admission.
cards.short_summary: Downtown contemporary-art museum with always-free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Broad states that it offers free general admission and identifies its Grand Avenue address.
cards.source_title: About The Broad
cards.access_notes: General admission is always free; reserve a free ticket before visiting when available.

cards.title: Spend time in CAAM’s galleries
cards.subtitle: 600 State Dr · Exposition Park
cards.notes: Choose a gallery day and head to Exposition Park for exhibitions centered on African American history, art, and culture; reservations are not required.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission museum in Exposition Park with rotating galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: CAAM states that admission is free, reservations are not required, and lists its Exposition Park address.
cards.source_title: Visit | California African American Museum
cards.access_notes: Admission is free and reservations are not required; visit during posted gallery hours.

cards.title: Try the permanent Science Center galleries
cards.subtitle: 700 Exposition Park Dr · Exposition Park
cards.notes: Stick to the permanent exhibition galleries for a no-cost outing, and skip ticketed special exhibitions or IMAX if you are keeping the visit at zero dollars.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on science exhibits with free permanent-gallery admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Exposition Park states that California Science Center permanent exhibition galleries are free, excluding IMAX and special exhibits.
cards.source_title: Exposition Park Venues
cards.access_notes: Permanent exhibition galleries are free; IMAX and special exhibits are excluded.

cards.title: Take a Central Library art and architecture tour
cards.subtitle: 630 W Fifth St · Downtown Los Angeles
cards.notes: Meet a docent in the Main Lobby for the scheduled art-and-architecture tour, then use the self-guided materials to continue exploring the historic building.
cards.short_summary: A free, docent-led look at Central Library’s art and architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Angeles Public Library states that all Central Library docent tours are free and lists the tour schedule and meeting point.
cards.source_title: Free Tours of the Historic Central Library
cards.access_notes: Tours are free and run on a limited schedule; check the library’s current schedule before going.

cards.title: Explore global arts at the Fowler
cards.subtitle: 308 Charles E Young Dr N · UCLA
cards.notes: Visit during the Wednesday–Sunday schedule and give yourself time for the changing exhibitions as well as the museum’s ongoing installations.
cards.short_summary: UCLA museum for global arts and cultures with always-free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fowler Museum states that admission is always free and provides its address and current open days.
cards.source_title: Visit | Fowler Museum at UCLA
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; open Wednesday through Sunday during posted hours.

cards.title: See free general-admission exhibitions at MOCA
cards.subtitle: 250 S Grand Ave · Downtown Los Angeles
cards.notes: Reserve a free general-admission ticket before leaving, then use the visit to see the exhibitions included at MOCA’s Grand Avenue location.
cards.short_summary: MOCA’s flagship galleries offer free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: MOCA states that all exhibitions on view at Grand Avenue are included in free general admission and recommends advance reservations.
cards.source_title: MOCA Hours, Tickets & Admission
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; advance reservations are recommended and a limited number of tickets may be available on site.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten LMU study settings with documented seating, technology, room features, or reservation requirements; the title is editorial framing, not a crowding claim.

cards.title: Settle In at Rose Hills
cards.subtitle: A designated reading room on Level 2 of William H. Hannon Library
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work and head to Level 2; confirm the library’s current hours before relying on building access.
cards.short_summary: A named library reading room for focused, text-heavy work.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies the Rose Hills Reading Room as a study space located on Level 2 of William H. Hannon Library.
cards.source_title: About the Library - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Located inside William H. Hannon Library on Level 2; consult the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Thomas and Dorothy Leavey Foundation Information Commons
cards.title: Work From the Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Computers, printers, help, and group rooms on Hannon Library’s first level
cards.notes: Use this stop when your work needs a computer or printing; check library access and printing requirements before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A technology-centered workspace that keeps research help and production tools nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that the Information Commons contains an Information Desk, printers, group study rooms, and Mac computers capable of running a Windows virtual desktop.
cards.source_title: Information Commons @ the Library - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Inside William H. Hannon Library; computer and building access remain subject to current university and library rules.

cards.title: Spread Out in Daum 218
cards.subtitle: A reservable six-person room with a long table and whiteboard wall
cards.notes: Reserve through myLMU, bring a group of no more than six, and use the long table and whiteboard wall to organize shared work.
cards.short_summary: A larger ARC room suited to collaborative planning and web-enabled meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU describes Daum Hall 218 as a reservable room with a long table, whiteboard wall, web-conferencing capability, and occupancy of up to six people.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Room Reservations menu in myLMU. Reservations may be made for blocks of up to two hours; maximum occupancy is six.

cards.title: Take a Small Group to Daum 217
cards.subtitle: A compact reservable room with two whiteboards and web conferencing
cards.notes: Book the room through myLMU for up to two hours, then use its two whiteboards for a quiet solo session or small-group review.
cards.short_summary: A compact ARC option for quiet work or collaboration among three to four people.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says Daum Hall 217 has a small table, two whiteboards, web-conferencing capability, and a capacity of three to four people.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Reserve through myLMU; room reservations are limited to blocks of up to two hours. LMU lists capacity as three to four people.

cards.title: Reset in the Decompression Zone
cards.subtitle: A private low-light room for reflection, journaling, or quiet re-centering
cards.notes: Reserve through myLMU and use the low-light room for journaling or a quiet reset; keep the visit to one or two people.
cards.short_summary: A private ARC room designed for a quieter pause between demanding work sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU describes Daum Hall 216 as a private room for students and staff with low lighting, lounge furniture, and a table for journaling or coloring.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Reserve through myLMU; reservations may last up to two hours. LMU limits the room to one or two people.

cards.title: Plug In at Theology Village
cards.subtitle: A University Hall general-purpose computing space with two Windows machines
cards.notes: Choose this room when a Windows workstation will advance the assignment; bring files digitally because LMU lists no printer here.
cards.short_summary: A small general-purpose computer setting for workstation-dependent coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Theology Village in University Hall 3700 as a general-purpose learning space with two Windows computers and no printer.
cards.source_title: Labs & Learning Spaces - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: LMU categorizes this as a general-purpose space. Confirm current University Hall and room access before visiting; no printer is listed.

cards.title: Draft at Modern Language Village
cards.subtitle: A two-computer general-purpose workspace in University Hall
cards.notes: Use one of the listed Windows computers for digital coursework, and plan any printing elsewhere because this room has no listed printer.
cards.short_summary: A compact computer workspace for assignments that need a campus Windows machine.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Modern Language Village in University Hall 3900 as a general-purpose learning space with two Windows computers and no printer.
cards.source_title: Labs & Learning Spaces - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: LMU categorizes this as a general-purpose space. Verify current University Hall and room access; no printer is listed.

cards.title: Build the Paper in Political Science Village
cards.subtitle: Six Windows computers and a printer in University Hall 4100
cards.notes: Bring your OneCard if you expect to print, and use the six listed Windows stations for research, drafting, or document cleanup.
cards.short_summary: A general-purpose computing room that combines multiple workstations with on-site printing.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Political Science Village in University Hall 4100 with six Windows computers and one printer.
cards.source_title: Labs & Learning Spaces - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: LMU categorizes this as a general-purpose space. Confirm room access; LMU says most campus-space printers require a OneCard.

cards.title: Tackle Computer Work in Psychology Village
cards.subtitle: A 16-station Windows workspace with a printer in University Hall
cards.notes: Use this room for computer-heavy work, and carry your OneCard if printing is part of the session because LMU flags that requirement.
cards.short_summary: A larger general-purpose computer setting with sixteen Windows workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Psychology Village in University Hall 4700 with sixteen Windows computers and one printer.
cards.source_title: Labs & Learning Spaces - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: LMU categorizes this as a general-purpose space. Verify current access; LMU says most listed printers require a OneCard.

cards.title: Finish Digital Work at Economics Village
cards.subtitle: Three Windows computers in a fourth-floor University Hall workspace
cards.notes: Use the three listed Windows machines for digital tasks, and arrange printing at another campus location because none is listed here.
cards.short_summary: A small fourth-floor computing space for focused digital coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Economics Village on University Hall’s fourth floor as a general-purpose learning space with three Windows computers and no printer.
cards.source_title: Labs & Learning Spaces - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: LMU categorizes this as a general-purpose space. Confirm current University Hall access before visiting; no printer is listed.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Westchester and Playa Vista corridors in LMU’s practical off-campus orbit, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Set Up at the Student Zone
cards.subtitle: Manchester Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Manchester Avenue to a public branch with a Student Zone, Wi-Fi, computers, bike rack, and recurring community programming.
cards.short_summary: A civic study stop with student-oriented space and practical library resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The branch is at 7114 W. Manchester Avenue and lists a Student Zone, public computers, Wi-Fi, a bike rack, and scheduled events.
cards.source_title: Westchester - Loyola Village | Los Angeles Public Library
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours vary by day; the branch is closed Sundays. Check the official page before leaving campus.

cards.title: Browse an Independent Bookshop
cards.subtitle: West 87th Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto West 87th Street to browse The Book Jewel and check its calendar for author talks and community arts programming.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood bookstore with a documented public-events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Book Jewel identifies its location as 6259 W. 87th Street and publishes bookstore hours and public events on its official website.
cards.source_title: Second Saturday Stroll & LPS | The Book Jewel
cards.access_notes: The cited page lists regular store hours; confirm the current calendar before attending a specific event.

cards.title: Find a Pool and Fitness Studios
cards.subtitle: Sepulveda Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Head down Sepulveda Boulevard when you need a facility with indoor pools, exercise studios, cardio equipment, and racquetball courts.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose recreation center serving the Westchester corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The YMCA lists its address as 8015 S. Sepulveda Boulevard and documents indoor heated pools, exercise studios, fitness equipment, and racquetball courts.
cards.source_title: Westchester Family YMCA - YMCA of Metropolitan Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: The official page posts daily facility hours. Membership, registration, eligibility, or reservations may apply to amenities and programs.

cards.title: Meet Over Daily Brunch
cards.subtitle: Truxton Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Truxton Avenue for a daytime meal; the Westchester location documents a daily brunch window alongside its regular service.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down neighborhood restaurant with a clearly documented brunch schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Truxton’s official location page places the restaurant at 8611 Truxton Avenue and lists daily brunch from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
cards.source_title: Truxton’s Westchester – Truxton's American Bistro
cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts separate regular and brunch hours; check the official page for current service details.

cards.title: See an Art-and-Design Campus
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Lincoln Boulevard and reserve an Otis tour to see departments, student work, and the college’s residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A neighboring art-and-design campus offering scheduled prospective-student tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Otis identifies the Goldsmith Campus at 9045 Lincoln Boulevard and offers registration for student-led tours covering departments, student work, and the residence hall.
cards.source_title: Campus Tours | Otis College of Art and Design
cards.access_notes: Advance registration is required for the scheduled campus tours shown on the official admissions calendar.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi and Public Computers
cards.subtitle: Playa Vista Drive corridor
cards.notes: Take Playa Vista Drive to a public branch with Wi-Fi, computers, wireless printing, a parking lot, and a bike rack.
cards.short_summary: A second public-library option serving the Playa Vista side of LMU’s orbit.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is at 6400 Playa Vista Drive and lists public computers, Wi-Fi, wireless printing, a parking lot, and a bike rack.
cards.source_title: Playa Vista | Los Angeles Public Library
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours vary by day; the branch is closed Sundays. Check the official page before visiting.

cards.title: Read the Watershed Outdoors
cards.subtitle: Bluff Creek Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow Bluff Creek Drive to explore a 1.7-acre open-air science and cultural exhibit focused on the Ballona Watershed.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor interpretive park developed with LMU and Gabrielino/Tongva guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Ballona Discovery Park describes itself as a 1.7-acre open-air science and cultural exhibit at 13110 Bluff Creek Drive, open daily from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Ballona Discovery Park
cards.access_notes: The park states that it is open to the public daily from dawn to dusk; remain within the designated public park area.

cards.title: Catch a Film with Accessibility Features
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use Jefferson Boulevard for a movie outing with documented closed captioning, descriptive narration, and assisted-listening options.
cards.short_summary: A Runway cinema whose listings identify accessibility formats by screening.
cards.evidence_claim: Cinemark locates this theater at 12746 W. Jefferson Boulevard and marks screenings with closed-caption, descriptive-narration, and assisted-listening features.
cards.source_title: Movie Theater In Playa Vista, CA: Cinemark Playa Vista & XD
cards.access_notes: Showtimes, ratings, formats, and accessibility features vary by film; consult the current official listing before purchasing.

cards.title: Pick Up Groceries and Prepared Food
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Stop along Jefferson Boulevard for groceries or choose among the store’s documented pizza, sandwich, juice, coffee, and taqueria counters.
cards.short_summary: A grocery stop with several named prepared-food counters under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Whole Foods places its Playa Vista store at 12746 W. Jefferson Boulevard and lists pizza, sandwich, juice, coffee, and taqueria counters.
cards.source_title: Playa Vista Store | Whole Foods Market
cards.access_notes: The store page posts current grocery hours; individual food counters may operate on different schedules.

cards.title: Combine Errands at One Retail Hub
cards.subtitle: Runway Road and Jefferson Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Runway Road or Jefferson Boulevard to combine a cinema, grocery stop, restaurants, shops, and creative pop-ups in one complex.
cards.short_summary: A named mixed-use destination consolidating several practical errands and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Playa Vista’s official visitor page describes Runway as a hub for restaurants, shops, fitness studios, and creative pop-ups in central Playa Vista.
cards.source_title: New Homes In L.A. | Playa Vista
cards.access_notes: Access and operating hours differ by tenant and event; consult the relevant destination page before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented LMU observances and community traditions rooted in the university’s Catholic, Jesuit, and Marymount identity.

cards.title: Start the year with the Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Annual LMU academic-year opening liturgy
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry announcements at the start of the academic year, then join the campus prayer for guidance and wisdom.
cards.short_summary: LMU marks each academic year’s opening with this Jesuit observance.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that the beginning of each academic year is marked by the Mass of the Holy Spirit.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Date and location vary by academic year; consult LMU Campus Ministry announcements.

cards.title: Attend Misa de Herencia
cards.subtitle: LMU’s Latinx Heritage Month liturgy
cards.notes: Look for the annual Latinx Heritage Month calendar and attend this campus liturgy if its timing fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: A named annual Catholic celebration within LMU’s Latinx Heritage Month programming.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Misa de Herencia among its annual Catholic celebrations during Latinx Heritage Month.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Annual timing is tied to Latinx Heritage Month; verify the current program with Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Find the Pistahan celebration
cards.subtitle: LMU feast of Filipino saints
cards.notes: Watch the Campus Ministry calendar for Pistahan, then experience the university’s listed celebration of Filipino saints.
cards.short_summary: A named annual LMU observance celebrating Filipino saints.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies Pistahan, a feast of Filipino saints, as one of its annual Catholic celebrations.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Annual event details are announced by LMU Campus Ministry.

cards.entity_name: Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe
cards.title: Observe LMU’s Guadalupe feast
cards.subtitle: Annual campus Catholic celebration
cards.notes: Check the December Campus Ministry schedule for the university’s Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe observance.
cards.short_summary: LMU includes this Marian feast in its annual Catholic calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists the Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe among its annual Catholic celebrations.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Verify current date, time, and location through Campus Ministry.

cards.entity_name: Vespers in the African American Tradition
cards.title: Attend vespers in the African American tradition
cards.subtitle: Annual LMU Catholic celebration
cards.notes: Use the Campus Ministry calendar to locate this annual vespers service and follow posted participation guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named annual worship tradition reflecting the diversity of LMU’s Catholic community.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists vespers in the African American tradition among its annual Catholic celebrations.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Annual event details are announced by LMU Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Honor graduates at Commencement Mass
cards.subtitle: LMU’s annual graduating-class liturgy
cards.notes: If visiting during commencement season, consult LMU’s published ceremony information for the current Mass arrangements.
cards.short_summary: A campus liturgy celebrating graduates and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says it celebrates each graduating class with Commencement Mass, including blessings for graduates and their families.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Held during commencement season; confirm guest access and event specifics before attending.

cards.title: Join LMU’s weekly Rosary
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry prayer gathering
cards.notes: Check the weekly Campus Ministry schedule and arrive ready to participate respectfully in the student Rosary gathering.
cards.short_summary: A recurring LMU student prayer practice.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that students gather weekly to pray the Rosary.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Weekly schedule and location can change; verify with Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Experience Exalt
cards.subtitle: LMU evening of prayer, music, reflection, and fellowship
cards.notes: Find the next Exalt through Campus Ministry, then attend the evening gathering for prayer, music, reflection, and fellowship.
cards.short_summary: A named LMU evening worship and reflection gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies Exalt as an evening of prayer, music, reflection, and fellowship for students.
cards.source_title: Catholic Activities at LMU
cards.access_notes: Check Campus Ministry for the current schedule and location.

cards.title: Mark Ignatian Heritage Month
cards.subtitle: LMU’s November identity-and-mission celebration
cards.notes: Visit the Us, Here, Now program page in November and choose a session that connects LMU history with present-day action.
cards.short_summary: LMU’s annual campus-wide November celebration of its Jesuit and Marymount identity.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU describes Us, Here, Now as its annual celebration of identity and mission, held throughout November.
cards.source_title: Us, Here, Now: Ignatian Heritage Month
cards.access_notes: Occurs each November; individual sessions and locations vary by year.

cards.title: Volunteer for LMU Special Games
cards.subtitle: Annual non-competitive community games program
cards.notes: Follow the Pam Rector Center for Service and Action for volunteer information, then support athletes and the day’s non-competitive activities.
cards.short_summary: A student-led LMU service tradition bringing athletes, volunteers, and the wider L.A. community together.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says Special Games has been an annual tradition since 1977, with non-competitive games and activities for people with intellectual and physical disabilities.
cards.source_title: LMU Special Games Enhanced with Rams Partnership
cards.access_notes: Volunteer roles and event dates are organized annually; confirm current participation details with LMU service programs.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Loyola Marymount University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative first-weekend sequence linking ten documented LMU destinations, from a campus orientation loop to art, recreation, gardens, and an outdoor gathering place.

cards.title: Start at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · find the campus crossroads
cards.notes: Begin inside Malone; locate the bookstore, dining facilities, Campus Ministry, student government, KXLU, and club spaces for later visits.
cards.short_summary: Use LMU’s student-activity hub to get oriented before the weekend begins.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that Malone Student Center contains dining facilities, a coffee bar, the bookstore, Campus Ministry, student government offices, KXLU, clubs, and other student activities.
cards.source_title: Malone Student Center - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: The official place page identifies it as a campus building but does not publish current building hours; follow posted access notices.

cards.title: Pause at Sacred Heart Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · enter through the temporary west-door route
cards.notes: Walk to the chapel, approach quietly, and use the west doors beside the Sculpture Garden while the front-entry renovation remains underway.
cards.short_summary: Visit LMU’s documented spiritual center while respecting its active worship role.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies Sacred Heart Chapel as the spiritual center of campus and says that, during front-entry renovation from June 1 through August 28, 2026, access is through the west doors beside the Sculpture Garden.
cards.source_title: Reserving LMU Chapels - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Through August 28, 2026, the university directs visitors to the west doors adjacent to the Sculpture Garden; worship and approved uses take priority.

cards.title: Continue Through the Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · connect the chapel to the bluff
cards.notes: Step into the named garden beside Sacred Heart Chapel and use it as the quiet transition toward LMU’s upper-campus outdoor spaces.
cards.short_summary: Link two campus landmarks through the garden explicitly named in LMU’s access directions.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU’s current chapel-access notice identifies the Sculpture Garden as the campus space adjacent to Sacred Heart Chapel’s west doors.
cards.source_title: Reserving LMU Chapels - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: The source confirms the garden’s campus location but gives no operating hours; respect chapel activity, renovation signs, and temporary routing.

cards.title: Learn the Library Layout
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · identify study and research options
cards.notes: Survey the collections, study areas, computer labs, and campus-view spaces now, so your first academic visit starts with a familiar route.
cards.short_summary: Turn the first evening into a practical preview of LMU’s principal library.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU’s first-year orientation page describes Hannon Library tours featuring its collections, study spaces with views, computer labs, and library resources.
cards.source_title: First-year Student Schedule - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Current LMU affiliates should carry a valid OneCard; the library’s visitor policy reserves access after 10 p.m. for LMU and LLS affiliates.

cards.title: Meet Up on Drollinger Field
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · use an established orientation gathering point
cards.notes: Make the field an easy group rendezvous; LMU’s first-year schedule already uses this named outdoor venue for a residential student social.
cards.short_summary: Choose a recognizable campus field for a low-pressure first-night meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU’s current first-year orientation schedule lists a Residential First-year Social at Drollinger Field from 7 to 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: First-year Student Schedule - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Use the field only when it is open and not reserved for scheduled programming; the orientation listing does not establish general public hours.

cards.title: Try the Burns Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · choose one familiar activity
cards.notes: Bring your OneCard, complete the applicable waiver, and pick one manageable option such as the fitness center, pool, courts, or group fitness.
cards.short_summary: Start Saturday with a student recreation option supported by clear access rules.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU says full-time undergraduate membership includes the fitness center, multipurpose courts, tennis courts, group fitness classes, and swimming pool.
cards.source_title: Cost & Eligibility - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Entry requires a valid OneCard or photo ID. Full-time undergraduates need the applicable waiver; students under 18 require a parent or guardian signature.

cards.title: See What Is Showing at Laband
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · check the exhibition before walking over
cards.notes: Confirm that an exhibition is installed, then visit during Saturday gallery hours and give yourself time to look closely rather than rush through.
cards.short_summary: Add a focused visual-arts stop with current hours and admission guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU lists Laband Art Gallery admission as free, Saturday hours as 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., and notes that it closes between exhibitions and on most campus holidays.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: Saturday hours are 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Check the current exhibition page first because the gallery closes between shows and on most campus holidays.

cards.title: Find LION’s Garden
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · connect food and urban agriculture
cards.notes: Locate the garden and read any on-site guidance before entering or handling plants; treat the visit as an introduction to LMU food sustainability.
cards.short_summary: See the campus garden LMU ties to urban-farming education and community produce.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU states that LION’s Garden educates students about urban farming and food sustainability while providing free organic produce to the community.
cards.source_title: Green Wellness - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: The university page documents the garden’s purpose but not public hours or harvesting rules; follow posted signs and take produce only when invited.

cards.title: Slow Down at Twin Oaks
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · observe a campus biodiversity space
cards.notes: Take a quiet observational loop around the pollinator garden, stay on established paths, and photograph plants without disturbing wildlife.
cards.short_summary: Begin Sunday in a named green space designed to support campus biodiversity.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU identifies Twin Oaks Pollinator Garden as a campus green space that supports biodiversity and offers students a place to unwind.
cards.source_title: Green Wellness - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: No hours are published on the cited university page; visit only through open campus routes and follow all garden signage.

cards.entity_name: Drollinger Family Stage at Lawton Plaza
cards.title: Finish at the Drollinger Family Stage
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · check the calendar, then regroup outdoors
cards.notes: End at the Lawton Plaza lawn, note the stage layout, and check LMU’s calendar for an appropriate public program before planning a return.
cards.short_summary: Close the route at LMU’s documented open-air performance and event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: LMU describes the Drollinger Family Stage as a modern outdoor performance and event venue in Lawton Plaza with flexible lawn seating and built-in audiovisual technology.
cards.source_title: Drollinger Family Stage at Lawton Plaza - Loyola Marymount University
cards.access_notes: The venue page does not publish general hours. Check the LMU calendar for scheduled events and avoid entering reserved production areas.
